Principle: Organize by user task; one primary category and only meaningful secondary workflows. Groups limit sidebar complexity.

Categories.Name: Browsers
Categories.Scope: Browse websites.
Categories.Excludes: Email clients, VPNs and download managers.

Categories.Name: Chat & Email
Categories.Scope: Email, messaging, voice chat and meetings.
Categories.Excludes: Web browsers and remote-desktop control.

Categories.Name: Office & PDFs
Categories.Scope: Documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, ebooks and research citations.
Categories.Excludes: Personal task managers and notebooks.

Categories.Name: Notes & Tasks
Categories.Scope: Notes, knowledge bases, reminders, tasks and personal planning.
Categories.Excludes: PDF readers, office suites and email.

Categories.Name: AI Tools
Categories.Scope: General AI assistants and local model/workflow tools.
Categories.Excludes: Code editors stay in Development; creative AI also appears in Design.

Categories.Name: Media Players
Categories.Scope: Listen to music and watch videos, including streaming clients.
Categories.Excludes: Video editors, DAWs, image viewers and server software.

Categories.Name: Photo Viewers
Categories.Scope: Browse, view and organize images.
Categories.Excludes: Primary photo processing, drawing and design tools.

Categories.Name: Gaming
Categories.Scope: Play games, launchers, emulators, mods and game streaming.
Categories.Excludes: Game creation engines and chat clients.

Categories.Name: Video Editing
Categories.Scope: Edit, cut, grade, composite, convert and encode video.
Categories.Excludes: Playback clients and screen-capture tools.

Categories.Name: Audio Production
Categories.Scope: Record, edit, compose, mix, master and process music/audio.
Categories.Excludes: Music players and Windows output-volume/EQ controls.

Categories.Name: Capture & Streaming
Categories.Scope: Screenshots, screen recording and live broadcasting.
Categories.Excludes: Video post-production and game-streaming clients.

Categories.Name: Design & Photography
Categories.Scope: Draw, design layouts/vectors/interfaces and process photographs.
Categories.Excludes: Photo browsing and 3D modeling.

Categories.Name: 3D & CAD
Categories.Scope: 3D modeling, engineering CAD and 3D-print preparation.
Categories.Excludes: Game launchers and code-first game development.

Categories.Name: Files & Downloads
Categories.Scope: File management, archives, transfers, downloads and comparison.
Categories.Excludes: Cloud-sync/backup services and disk hardware diagnostics.

Categories.Name: Cloud & Backup
Categories.Scope: Synchronize devices/cloud folders and back up data.
Categories.Excludes: One-off file transfers and encryption utilities.

Categories.Name: Media Servers
Categories.Scope: Host and distribute personal music/video libraries.
Categories.Excludes: Client players and recording/broadcast software.

Categories.Name: Security & Privacy
Categories.Scope: Passwords, authentication, encryption, antivirus, firewalls and privacy VPNs.
Categories.Excludes: Remote-desktop clients and general network diagnostics.

Categories.Name: Remote Access
Categories.Scope: Remote desktops, remote support and shared input across computers.
Categories.Excludes: Network analyzers and VPN infrastructure without desktop control.

Categories.Name: Network Tools
Categories.Scope: Network diagnostics, SSH/serial tools and private-network/VPN infrastructure.
Categories.Excludes: Browsers and commercial privacy VPN services.

Categories.Name: Development
Categories.Scope: Code editors, IDEs, languages/SDKs, version control, API/database tools and game engines.
Categories.Excludes: Dependencies needed only to run other apps.

Categories.Name: Windows Utilities
Categories.Scope: Desktop customization, automation, accessibility and Windows/app maintenance.
Categories.Excludes: Drivers, hardware monitoring, archives, networking and runtime dependencies.

Categories.Name: Hardware & Drivers
Categories.Scope: Drivers, peripherals, RGB, sensors, benchmarks, tuning and hardware diagnostics.
Categories.Excludes: General Windows utilities and audio mixing/production.

Categories.Name: Audio Controls
Categories.Scope: Windows volume, equalization, output devices and audio routing.
Categories.Excludes: Music/video players and full audio-production workstations.

Categories.Name: Runtimes
Categories.Scope: Shared runtime/codec components required to run applications.
Categories.Excludes: Language SDKs used to develop programs.
